bio: Reassuring Ligurian cuisine in a classic interpretation and in a “Historical Restaurant of Italy”, where the same family always keeps up with the times, served in two separate rooms: one with a traditional tone, the other more modern. It is interesting to browse through the menu and wine list with historical notes and useful information on grape varieties. The many seafood dishes are accompanied by timeless local specialities, such as cima alla genovese. The focaccia with cheese is proverbial!...
